pipeline.title: Data Extraction
pipeline.desc: Extract raw files, EVT/EVTX logs, registry hives, and prefetch from disk.

pipeline.title: Chain of Custody
pipeline.desc: Compute SHA-256 hashes of all raw extracted artifacts.

pipeline.title: Feature Engineering
pipeline.desc: Generate 17-feature matrix and file index from MFT and logs.

pipeline.title: ML Anomaly Detection (v1)
pipeline.desc: Train Isolation Forest model & output flagged anomalies.

pipeline.title: Burst Detection (v2)
pipeline.desc: Perform MFT temporal burst analysis & train Isolation Forest v2.

pipeline.title: Confidence Calibration
pipeline.desc: Rank flagged anomalies into CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW tiers.

pipeline.title: MITRE ATT&CK Mapping
pipeline.desc: Map anomaly signatures to adversary tactics & Navigator layer.

pipeline.title: Explainable AI (SHAP)
pipeline.desc: Compute SHAP attribution values & waterfall/beeswarm plots.

pipeline.title: Timeline Generation
pipeline.desc: Construct sorted events CSV and interactive HTML timeline.

pipeline.title: Remediation Scripts
pipeline.desc: Generate PowerShell containment files for detected breach indicators.

pipeline.title: HTML Report Assembly
pipeline.desc: Validate CoC, compile findings, and generate premium HTML dashboard.

pipeline.title: Baseline Benchmark
pipeline.desc: Evaluate equal-budget retrieval against rules, k-NN, and ablations.
